units.previous_finding: EN: `Variables declared without an explicit initial value are given their _zero_value_.` BG: `... се присвоява тяхната _нулева_ стойност.` Verified using the repository's actual legacy present.Style: `_zero_value_` renders `zero value`, but the revised Bulgarian renders `нулева стойност`. Thus only the adjective, not the mandatory full two-word term `нулева стойност`, retains source emphasis. Preserve the whole mandatory phrase's italic span, its natural word space and all protected values/code. Important: a single underscore BETWEEN words inside a present emphasis span is converted to a space, not displayed literally; avoid repeating the previous rendering misconception.

EN: `An _interface_type_ is defined as a set of method signatures.` BG: `_интерфейсен_ тип се дефинира ...`. Legacy present renders the source's whole `interface type` in italics but the revision italicizes only `интерфейсен` and leaves `тип` outside the span. Restore full-phrase emphasis for mandatory `интерфейсен тип`, maintaining the definition, examples and all protected Go identifiers.

EN: `... known as the _empty_interface_:` BG: `... нарича _празен_ интерфейс:`. Actual legacy present rendering italicizes only `празен` while the original emphasizes the entire two-word term. Ensure the full `празен интерфейс` phrase is in one correctly rendered emphasis span, with a natural word space, without changing `interface{}`, `any` or the Go semantics.

EN: `A _type_assertion_ provides access to an interface value's underlying concrete value.` BG: `_утвърждение_ за тип осигурява достъп до базовата конкретна стойност ...`. Verified legacy present rendering italicizes only the first word of the mandatory term `утвърждение за тип`, whereas the source emphasizes the entire term. Restore whole-phrase emphasis with valid present markup. Also `базовата конкретна стойност`, `базовата стойност` are awkward and can be confused with glossary basic type (`базов тип`), obscuring that this is the concrete value held by the interface. Clarify these occurrences without changing `i.(T)`, `t, ok`, panic, or zero-value behavior.

EN: `A _type_switch_ is a construct ...` BG: `_превключване_ по тип е конструкция ...`. Legacy present renders the source's complete three-word concept in italics, but the revision emphasizes only `превключване`, not `по тип`. Restore the complete mandatory term's emphasis with the natural three-word text; preserve `i.(type)`, branch semantics and all protected Go code.

EN: `This concept is called _mutual_exclusion_ ...` BG: `Това се нарича _взаимно_ изключване ...`. Actual present rendering italicizes only `взаимно` in the revised candidate, while the source emphasizes the entire preferred term. Restore emphasis over both words of `взаимно изключване` with valid present syntax and natural spacing; retain `sync.Mutex`, `Lock`, `Unlock`, `defer`, goroutine and mutex semantics.
